sdgrow.title: SD card space
sdgrow.can: Mosaik uses only part of the card. Press A to expand the partition to the whole card; your files stay where they are.
sdgrow.full: Mosaik already uses all the space on the card.
sdgrow.cannot: This card can't be expanded from here. The reason is written below: copy it into your report.
sdgrow.done: The partition is expanded. Turn the console off and on again: at startup Mosaik finishes preparing the new space.
sdgrow.ask_body: The Mosaik partition will reach the end of the card. Files are not touched; to finish, turn the console off and on again.
sdgrow.done_manual: The partition is expanded. Turn the console off with the power button and on again: at start Mosaik finishes preparing the new space.
